name: Service Manager
title: Service Manager — Scytáles
description: Seamless integration, metadata access, and access control for mDLs, mIDs, Derived mIDs, and Digital Identity Wallets.

hero.headline: Seamless Integration and Security for Mobile Credentials
hero.sub: Enable seamless integration, metadata access, and access control for enhanced mobile identity solutions with the Scytáles Service Manager.
bullets: Primary interface to metadata for mDL, mID, Derived mID, and wallets
Access control for authorised personnel only
Signing service and key management on behalf of the issuer
Integrates with standalone PKI or Trusted Service Provider / CSP

showcase.statCopy: High-availability design for digital identity document issuance

discover.copy: Carry official physical and digital credentials on your phone with EUDI-ready wallet support.
NFC card authentication that derives credentials from security documents into mobile virtual IDs.
Authenticate a fleet of readers for secure online and offline data transfer from wallets and mIDs.

statement: The Scytáles Service Manager is the backbone interface for mobile identity ecosystems — pairing with validators, wallets, and CSPs so issuers can control access, metadata, and credential signing at scale.

benefits.title: Signing Service & Key Management
benefits.body: Signs mDLs, mIDs, Derived mIDs and Digital Identity Wallets on behalf of the issuer, to relay them to consumer devices.

benefits.title: Easy and Secure Integration
benefits.body: Secure API connections that keep data up to date, where wanted, to and from the system of record — a civil register from issuing authorities, or trusted identity providers / CSP at Level 3 Assurance.

benefits.title: High Availability for Mobile Identity Document Issuance
benefits.body: The Service Manager can issue every digital identity document to a mobile, and is designed for high availability of at least 99.99%.

benefits.title: Identity & Access Management
benefits.body: Registration and authentication for validators that need access to online services.

benefits.title: Complete Supply Chain with High-Level Security Mechanisms
benefits.body: Secures the complete supply chain, with the highest level of onboarding and several reading mechanisms over OIDC — Web-PC, local PC and peer-to-peer — in real time, online and offline.
